chunks: Jamil narrated from Zurarah, who said:

I asked Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام about a man who bought food specifically from a village. He said: "There is no harm. If it comes out, then it belongs to him; and if it does not come out, it is a debt upon him."

key_terms.اشْتَرَى: purchased or entered into a sale contract
key_terms.خَرَجَ: was produced or became available for delivery
key_terms.قَرْيَةٍ: a village as the specified source of the goods
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no legal objection or harm in the transaction

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to buy specified food from a village before receiving it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the purchase of specified food from a village. The transaction is permissible, and if the goods are delivered they belong to the buyer; if delivery does not occur, the matter is treated as a debt liability.
